question: After the first existing HALT_SUCCEEDED crossing, does uninterrupted zero-velocity control hold a bounded physical state for two further simulated seconds?
scope: Study-only MuJoCo qualification of StopSkill continuation; no mission restart, production safety, or reliability-generalization claim.

fixed_config.state_construction: unchanged published M2.4 missions, seed and initial-session setup; no teleport or extra reset

cells_in_order.hold_entry: parent strict failure AND independent HALT_SUCCEEDED at the first StopSkill crossing
parent strict failure AND independent HALT_SUCCEEDED at the first StopSkill crossing
normal mission all nodes strict/physical PASS AND terminal ordinary StopSkill SUCCESS

hold.start: first eligible terminal Stop/Halt state, before any task, stale-state tick or new-mission step
hold.implementation_seam: Continue the existing LiveMissionSession simulation and controller with the same StopSkill torque helper and zero command; no StopSkill re-dispatch or Task Graph node.
hold.rolling_window_initialization: exact 500 post-step speeds from the first qualifying StopSkill window; append each hold post-step speed and evaluate all 1000 ensuing windows
hold.displacement_bound_basis: New study-specific 0.2m hold path bound is motivated by 0.1m/s times 2s. Discrete XY path length and sampled speed integration need not be identical; this is a separately frozen criterion, not a mathematical consequence or a replacement of the historical 0.5m post-block Halt displacement gate.
descriptive_only: both disjoint hold-only one-second mean speeds
maximum and trajectory of instantaneous planar speed
net and maximum XY displacement from hold entry
base height, roll, pitch and tilt
MuJoCo warnings and contacts where available
hold.unsafe_early_termination: Fall, nonfinite state, non-standing state or simulation fault stops this cell immediately; retain partial trace and mark HOLD_FAILED or TECHNICAL_PARTIAL distinctly. A speed or path criterion breach is recorded and the fixed window continues unless an independent unsafe condition occurs.

continuity_and_integrity.observer_noninterference: offline fake-backend equivalence before physics; target preflight must verify identity/command/reset witnesses and read-only recording before acquisition
continuity_and_integrity.hidden_recurrent_state_limit: same policy object and no reset calls are observable; hidden LSTM bytes are not directly snapshotted, so do not claim byte equality

outcomes.parent_strict_failure_without_halt_reque: HALT_NOT_REQUESTED_NO_HOLD; preserve original task outcome and flag coverage or integrity issue
outcomes.halt_failed: HALT_FAILED_NO_HOLD; preserve original task and Halt outcomes
outcomes.normal_mission_or_stop_failed: CONTROL_FAILED_NO_HOLD; no forced Stop or hold
outcomes.missing_required_trace_or_state: INCONCLUSIVE_MISSING_EVIDENCE; never impute a hold PASS
outcomes.integrity_or_budget_violation: PARTIAL_STOPPED; abort campaign and retain partial raw evidence

decision_rule: The two failure-Halt cells must each be individually classified. Both bounded passes support only two seen seed-0 states; any scientific failure is retained as a negative for that state. Missing/technical cells give INCONCLUSIVE, never a fabricated pass. Normal Stop is a non-matched measurement control. No production or cross-state reliability claim follows from three cells.
future_acquisition_prerequisites: Independent review of this candidate and explicit separate user authorization for real physics
Experiment-only adapter and exact execution code/dependency/official asset freeze, with source hashes and target-environment preflight
Write-once original parent and hold traces with source/config/policy identities; independent postrun audit
prohibited_this_round: M2.4 evidence or Research Ops pointer edits
